literal: When desiring, one must desire non-birth; further, that, desirelessness by desiring, will come.
translation: If one must desire anything, one should desire not to be born again. That state of non-birth will come by seeking to be free from all desires.
modern: ஒருவர் எதையாவது விரும்பினால், இனி பிறக்காமல் இருப்பதையே விரும்ப வேண்டும். அந்தப் பிறவா நிலை, எந்த ஆசையும் இல்லாமல் இருப்பதையே விரும்புவதால் கிடைக்கும்.
explanation: This couplet plays on the word 'desire' to show how to overcome it. It states that if a person must wish for something, they should wish for an end to the cycle of birth. The second line explains how to achieve this: the state of non-birth is attained simply by desiring 'desirelessness' itself. By making the absence of desire the only goal, all other worldly attachments are severed.
